title: StatementAlignment
description: Correspondence between an informal claim and a Lean declaration (Section 5.4). Informal claims and Lean declarations are separate objects; a Lean proof verifies the informal claim only when an accepted reviewer marks this alignment exact. Otherwise the result is a verified nearby theorem with an explicit relation.

statement_hash.description: Content hash of the informal statement.

source_hash.description: Content hash of the Lean source declaring it.

quantifier_correspondence.description: How binders on each side correspond, e.g. 'forall a b : Nat <-> all a b in N'.

domain_correspondence.description: Domain of quantification on each side and any coercion between them.

relation.description: Direction of mismatch between informal claim and formal statement.

reviewer.description: Who accepted or rejected the correspondence.

status.description: Protocol-level lifecycle (Section 5.4). 'aligned'/'mismatch' are review outcomes; 'superseded'/'stale' retire the record.
